messages:
maria: quick async standup — gateway routing / auth / rate limits.

maria: what I did: finished config migration for route-weighting; smoke-tested canary in us-west.

maria: blocker: intermittent 403s when upstream returns 401 — not sure if token refresh or header rewrite.

maria: today: add extra logging + ping kevin for auth change.

kevin: I deployed the new auth proxy last night; it drops empty X-Client-Id headers. Can you paste a failing request?

maria: repro curl:
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'X-Client-Id:' https://gw.staging/api/echo
```
-> 403. upstream rejects due to missing client id, but proxy should rewrite from jwt claim.

alex: looks like proxy maps claim 'cid' only; jwt has 'client_id'. PR incoming #5432 to map both. Can you test with `-H 'X-Client-Id: 123'`?

maria: adding header returns 200. mapping is the issue. I'll wait on #5432. :pray:

sophia: rate-limits update: bumped token-bucket throttle to 120r/s for lambda routes in staging to match prod traffic. saw queue depth spike on bursts — may need batching tune. tracking ENG-657.

maria: noted. p95 latency spiked 80ms -> 140ms during burst; does that affect canary?

sophia: yes during warmup. I'll enable 'fastpass' for canary for 5m to avoid tail latency; will monitor SLOs.

kevin: merged #5432 to staging. @maria can you re-run the smokecheck?

maria: retested: curl without header -> 200 now. blocker cleared. Today I'll open a routing policy change to add a fallback variant for low-capacity regions. PR #5441 (review ping).

alex: will review after lunch. started e2e asserting routing fallback with `make e2e-gateway`.

deploy-bot: deploy complete: auth-proxy v2.4.1 -> staging (by kevin) :rocket:

maria: thanks all. I'll add logging to expose jwt->header mapping for next rollout and post results here.
